name: @cassicore/embeddings
description: Embedding + reranker services and shared posture/token utilities extracted from CassiCore. Self-contained HTTP clients (vLLM / zerank) plus SqliteVectorIndex, a tick-based background worker, and the shared posture-store / token-estimation composables. History-preserved import splice; depends on @cassicore/foundation + better-sqlite3 and a vendored gaming-mode runtime stub pending later phases.
